verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Metorial is infrastructure that lets AI agents and MCP clients call tools in third-party apps such as Slack and GitHub. Nothing shows a user can operate Metorial itself (managing providers, sessions, deployments or portals) through natural-language commands, for example via a built-in assistant or an MCP server for the platform's own management. Letting agents reach other apps is an adjacent capability and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
